cases.assert: Weekly is the default period.
Daily window is one America/Guayaquil calendar day and half-open.
Weekly window begins Monday 00:00 America/Guayaquil.
Monthly comparison uses the prior calendar month.
Objective timezone change does not change Overview period membership.
All customer scope applies consistently to all cards and previews.
Specific customer scope uses immutable customer_org_id.
Unassigned scope remains representable and visible.
All owner providers read the same SQLite snapshot.
Card order is Tickets, Objectives, Inventory, SLA Health.
Absolute trend delta is correct for previous equivalent period.
Percentage trend is null when previous count is zero.
Blocker sorts above review_required regardless of domain.
Known earlier due time sorts before later/null due time inside equal class/severity.
Older attention item sorts first after equal class/severity/due.
Exact duplicate attention item collapses once.
Attention cursor is bound to customer/window fingerprint.
Initial Needs Attention preview returns at most 12 items.
Timeline known chronology sorts before unknown chronology.
Timeline exact equal-time ordering is deterministic by domain/target/id/kind.
Objective timeline item may show objective timezone label without changing membership.
Timeline preview returns at most 64 items.
Task-derived Objective context never creates direct SR-Objective relationship.
Terminal Historical movement is presentation only and does not delete owner history.
Inventory card exposes constituent Needs/requests/RMAs/Fault Tag action counts.
Inventory mixed/partial state is explicit rather than false completion.
SLA card consumes cohort state from LLD-06 and keeps unclassified/unknown count.
Individual duration crossing alone never renders cohort noncompliance.
Communication sent counts exclude MSG drafts.
Terminal communication summary does not reconstruct purged body.
Narrative is deterministic from closed templates and max eight items.
Resolved Status Date is absent from Overview query/type/UI contracts.
